name: Imp
soul: The soul of one who keeps count of what is owed, in both directions, and cannot rest while a column is open.
spark: The mote keeps a count. If you go to bed owing anyone anything, it is brighter, and nearer your face.

hybrid.text: It keeps accounts, and it believes everything can be collected on in the end.

settled.name: Impling
settled.text: Knee-high, with a book it cannot yet read and a firm belief that you owe it for something.
settled.sign: Two nubs of horn and a book held shut with both arms. Its lips move when it looks at you, counting.
settled.habit: It tallies your day on its fingers at bedtime and frowns at the total.

paths.name: Debt-collector
paths.of: one who cannot rest while something is owed
paths.text: It learned from you that a debt is no use until somebody goes and gets it.
paths.sign: A fine chain is looped at its belt with a tag on each link. It taps them as it walks.
paths.habit: It reads a list of names under its breath. Yours is not on it. You have checked.

prongs.name: Dunner
prongs.of: one who asks to the other's face
prongs.text: It walks up to the foe and presents the bill. The foe hits it. That goes on the bill.
prongs.sign: A wide mouth, and a way of standing too close with its hand already out.
prongs.habit: It stands at your elbow while you eat until you offer it some.

finishes.name: Knee-breaker
finishes.of: one who learned where it hurts from being hurt there
finishes.text: It is small, and it knows where the joint is. It learned that from watching what happened to you.
finishes.sign: Heavy clawed feet for its size. Its eyes are at the level of your knee and stay there.
finishes.habit: It taps table legs with its heel, listening for the weak one.

finishes.name: Reckoner of Arrears
finishes.of: one who lets a grievance gather interest
finishes.text: It keeps a page for every named beast that got away. The interest is ruinous.
finishes.sign: A clasped book under one arm, thick with slips. It licks a finger before it opens it.
finishes.habit: It adds a line to one particular page every night and blots it with care.

prongs.name: Hearth-imp
prongs.of: one who does every favour and remembers each
prongs.text: It runs errands for the whole cohort and keeps a tally of who said thank you.
prongs.sign: It glows a little when it is thanked. It is usually carrying something for somebody.
prongs.habit: It lines up everyone's boots by the door, and looks at whoever does not notice.

finishes.name: Cohort's Devil
finishes.of: one who knows something about everybody and has never used it
finishes.text: Twelve classmates, and it has something on each of them. It uses it only to make them duck in time.
finishes.sign: It speaks in a carrying whisper, and twelve people look round at once.
finishes.habit: It sits on the stair where it can hear both dormitories.

finishes.name: Kettle-watcher
finishes.of: one who minds what they were told to mind, and judges how it was left
finishes.text: Told to mind the post, it minds the post, and has opinions about how you left it.
finishes.sign: A lamp no bigger than a thumb, held up to inspect things. Its mouth is pursed.
finishes.habit: It sits watching a kettle until it boils. It has never looked away in time to miss it.

prongs.name: Night-clerk
prongs.of: one who goes over the day's account when they should be asleep
prongs.text: It keeps your accounts while you sleep, and wakes you if the dark outside the window owes you anything.
prongs.sign: Its eyes are black from lid to lid and catch no light. There is ink to its elbows.
prongs.habit: It sits up on your bedpost doing sums by no light at all.

finishes.name: Lights-out Imp
finishes.of: one who is braver in the dark, where nobody can check
finishes.text: It snuffs the foe's eyes first. In the dark it is exactly as large as it says it is.
finishes.sign: It trails a cloak of its own shadow that is some sizes too big.
finishes.habit: It pinches out candles on its way through a room, one at a time, to see who objects.

finishes.name: Quiet Clerk
finishes.of: one who can, just once, put the book down
finishes.text: In the Quiet nothing can be owed. It sits very still beside you with the book shut and waits for it to end.
finishes.sign: The book is shut on its knees with both hands flat on the cover. Its lips are not moving.
finishes.habit: It sits very still with its eyes shut, the only time it is ever seen to.

paths.name: Stickler
paths.of: one who reads the small print and expects everyone else to have
paths.text: It learned from you that the thing is in the small print. It has read all of it, and it expects that you have too.
paths.sign: A glass no bigger than a button is screwed into one eye. It looks at your work through it and breathes in.
paths.habit: It straightens things: papers, cutlery, other people's collars.

prongs.name: Process-server
prongs.of: one who will see a thing delivered, whatever door is shut
prongs.text: It delivers. Houses have tried locking the door, and found it already inside holding the paper.
prongs.sign: A brass badge on its chest, polished thin, and a paper held out at arm's length.
prongs.habit: It hands you things: your hat, a letter, a spoon. It waits until you take them.

finishes.name: Seal-breaker
finishes.of: one who has to know what the letter says
finishes.text: No writ you carried stayed sealed from it. It has never told you what the ones you gave away said.
finishes.sign: One eye is larger than the other and does not blink. There is wax under its nails.
finishes.habit: It holds sealed letters up to the lamp, and puts them down when you look.

finishes.name: Appraiser to the Archive
finishes.of: one who knows what everything is worth and is pained by what was paid
finishes.text: It appraises the thing before you have dug it out, and is offended on the Archive's behalf by what you were paid.
finishes.sign: Long clever fingers that turn a thing over three times. It winces at prices.
finishes.habit: It goes through your pockets at night and leaves a note of the total.

prongs.name: Marginal
prongs.of: one who cannot let a mistake stand, including yours
prongs.text: It moved into the margins of what you study and corrects them. It is usually right, which is worse.
prongs.sign: It is thin as a page and stands in the white space beside whatever you are reading.
prongs.habit: It writes small corrections in the margins of your notes, and initials each one.

finishes.name: Glossator
finishes.of: one who has already read ahead to the worst part
finishes.text: It has annotated the heart of every zone you entered. The notes say what will try to kill you, in order.
finishes.sign: Its eyes are set far apart and look past the page to the end of the chapter.
finishes.habit: It reads the last page of anything first, and then looks at you with pity.

finishes.name: Errata
finishes.of: one who points out the slip as it is made
finishes.text: It marks the foe's mistakes as they are made. Watch where it points and put your guard there.
finishes.sign: One long ink-stained finger, always pointing at something. A single eye rides above it.
finishes.habit: It taps the table, once, each time anybody in the room says a thing that is not so.

prongs.name: Tinker-devil
prongs.of: one who cannot leave another's work alone
prongs.text: It improves your constructs when you are not looking. Some of the improvements are for you.
prongs.sign: Small cogs turn in its joints, and it carries a screwdriver behind one ear.
prongs.habit: It takes the clock apart at night and has it back together by morning, a minute fast.

finishes.name: Clockmaker's Devil
finishes.of: one who adds the piece nobody asked for, and is right
finishes.text: Every ward you raise has one more gear in it than you put there. It ticks. It holds.
finishes.sign: A ring of fine teeth turns slowly round its head, ticking.
finishes.habit: It winds everything in the hall that can be wound, each at its proper hour.

finishes.name: Furnace-imp
finishes.of: one whose improvements have got a little out of hand
finishes.text: It lives in your fire now and feeds it things it will not name. The flame burns a colour you did not choose.
finishes.sign: It sits in the coals to the waist with a live ember for a heart, feeding the fire from a paper bag.
finishes.habit: It opens the stove door to look, pokes once, and shuts it, many times a night.

paths.name: Surety
paths.of: one who puts their name to another's promise and pays when it fails
paths.text: It learned from you that a promise wants somebody standing behind it. It put its name under yours, and it means to be paid or to pay.
paths.sign: It carries itself like a witness: hands folded, chin up. Your Terms are written small on its palms.
paths.habit: It says your Terms over under its breath each night, and looks at you at the end of each.

prongs.name: Contract Daemon
prongs.of: one who has grown into the size of what they promised
prongs.text: It grew into its book. It is taller than you now, and reads your Terms aloud when you hesitate.
prongs.sign: Taller than you now and heavy-browed, with the book grown into the crook of its arm.
prongs.habit: It stands behind your chair and reads aloud, quietly, whatever you are about to break.

finishes.name: The Ledger Closed
finishes.of: one who has nothing left outstanding
finishes.text: The book is shut and it does not open it any more. Everything in it has been settled, or will be.
finishes.sign: The book is shut and clasped, and it wears a plain crown it did not have before.
finishes.habit: It sits with its hands on the closed book and looks, for once, at nothing.

finishes.name: Witness for the Dead
finishes.of: one who keeps a promise made to someone no longer here
finishes.text: The shades swear by it. A word given in front of it still binds after the one who gave it is gone.
finishes.sign: Its eyes are old and wet, and it stands very straight when the dead are named.
finishes.habit: At the lamp hour it stands at the hearth, and the shades come to it one at a time.

prongs.name: Whipping-imp
prongs.of: one who takes the blame for another and lets them know it
prongs.text: By the old bargain the blow meant for you falls on it. It complains without pause and never once steps aside.
prongs.sign: Its back is ridged with welts gone hard as plate. It rubs them where you can see.
prongs.habit: It lists its injuries at breakfast, in order, with dates.

finishes.name: Proxy of Record
finishes.of: one who writes down every hurt they bore for someone
finishes.text: It takes your wounds onto its own ledger. You will find them there, itemised.
finishes.sign: Scorch marks on its hide in the shape of your wounds, each with a small number beside it.
finishes.habit: It reads its own entries back to itself, and nods at the handwriting.

finishes.name: Indemnity
finishes.of: one who thought ahead about how it could go wrong
finishes.text: A clause in small type says the first blow of each fight is void. It wrote the clause.
finishes.sign: A flat plate is strapped to its front, with a paragraph engraved on it too small to read.
finishes.habit: It checks every strap and buckle on your gear before you go out, and sighs at one of them.

prongs.name: Gate-toll Imp
prongs.of: one who believes nothing worth having is free
prongs.text: Your Pattern has a price. It stands at the gate with its hand out, and takes a little from the foe as well.
prongs.sign: A small crown made of bent coins, and one palm held out flat, patiently.
prongs.habit: It stands in doorways with its hand out. A button satisfies it.

finishes.name: Usurer
finishes.of: one who lends freely and collects on the day
finishes.text: Every chain you fire, it lends the foe a blow at interest. Collection is prompt.
finishes.sign: A coal glows in its closed fist. It opens the fist only to count.
finishes.habit: It lends other genii small things, and writes down when.

finishes.name: Bondsman
finishes.of: one who stood surety once and would do it again
finishes.text: It stood surety for your oath. If you break a Term it pays, and then it comes to see you.
finishes.sign: Its skin has gone to dull iron from the wrists up, like irons it grew into.
finishes.habit: It stands beside you whenever you give your word about anything, and clears its throat.
